title: Was the BEST experience in Barcelona!!
text: This was so worth the money!! Our driver was very knowledgeable and friendly. He was also very accommodating and attentive. He carried on a great conversation with us the whole time. We had done the hop on/hop off bus the day before…. Not worth it at all! This tour was soooooo worth the money!!! I highly recommend it.. and have to a few people headed to Barcelona. Our driver is even coming back to take us to the port.
author: Sandra_D

title: Highly recommended
text:
Our private two-hour tour of Barcelona was fascinating! Our driver was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and spoke excellent English. His excellent driving skills and clean, comfortable vehicle made us feel safe and relaxed throughout the tour.

He also gave us wonderful recommendations for places to eat and additional sights to explore. A fantastic way to discover Barcelona—we highly recommend this experience!
author: sandra_g

title: A great guide for an enjoyable and interesting tour.
text: We had a wonderful and knowledgeable young man, Kamalpreet Singh, who gave us a 2-hour tour of Barcelona.  Our time was limited but he packed a lot into the time.  He’s a real asset to his company, Welcome tours.   We were able to ask questions and get a lot of feedback as well as hearing his information.
author: B4818IPsylviar

title: tour guide exceptional
text: David was excellent in maximizing the time to see as many points of interest as possible and was very knowledgeable about the history of those places. The pick up was on time at the hotel.
author: albertoaT4111YG

title: A fun ride
text: Alberto was delightful. Very knowledgeable. Customized our tour to our needs. Great energy. Very thorough.
author: Valerie_G

title: Visit express
text: Excellent choice for short visits...Christian took us to the most emblematic places and gave us a brief guide to everything...we stopped at the places we were most interested in...thank you very much Cristian
author: 221nataliac

title: Highlights of Barcelona
text: We chose this tour as we had very limited time and a few family members were not able to walk long distances. An excellent choice, good car, perfect timing and a great guide who even helped push the wheelchair every now and again !
author: JulieR3336

title: Two Hour Tour in a Tesla Model S?
text:
Very very surprised to be picked up in a Tesla Model S.  One of the coolest cars on the whole planet.

And our driver was great.  Super knowledgeable and personable.

Had a great time.
author: Jonathan W

title: Great Tour of Barcelona in Two Hours
text: This is a great opportunity to get a quick glance at Barcelona from the convenience of a car ride instead of a bus. Our driver pick us up from the port and safely drove us on our tour. We would have been driven to our hotel, however, we arrived the day of the protests so we had to walk the last three blocks. The driver really felt bad but nothing could be done as the streets were closed. Highly recommended.
author: MaureenO205

title: Highlights of Barcelona
text: Driver was timely in meeting our cruise ship, very helpful with luggage for 4, was very familiar with the Highlights most want to see, helped with photo ops, plus altered his usual route to take us by some other places we wanted to see before dropping us off at our hotel.
author: Trail55782969160
